title: M9-C42.22 — Milestone M22.2 Discovery Analysis: behaviour_engine

analysis.no_tests_explanation: The 2,835 no_tests mutants (39.3% of 7,213) represent a discovery gap, not genuinely missing tests. Root cause: tests exercise the engine indirectly through integration/capability tests, but mutation configuration only selects unit/property tests that don't cover all internal utility functions.

NOT_DISCOVERED_TEST_EXISTS.description: Functions exercised by integration/capability tests but not bound to mutation test selection
NOT_DISCOVERED_TEST_EXISTS.evidence: test_integration.py (23 tests) + test_metrics.py (150 tests) + capability/pattern_analysis exercise core functions like compute_behavior_profile, detect_india_risk_patterns, behavioral indices, but mutation config only selects unit/property tests

NOT_DISCOVERED_TEST_MISSING.description: Functions with no direct test coverage - primarily utility/helpers in utils.py, stress.py, temporal.py
NOT_DISCOVERED_TEST_MISSING.evidence: No unit/property tests import functions from utils.py, stress.py, temporal.py directly; only core.py utility functions are tested

WRONG_SOURCE_BINDING.description: Mutants generated on internal/private functions (prefixed with x_ or _) that aren't public API
WRONG_SOURCE_BINDING.evidence: Mutation generation targets all functions including internal helpers like _parse_date, _coefficient_of_variation, _moving_average that are implementation details

INFRASTRUCTURE_ISSUE.description: Cache/storage functions and re-exports that don't have independent behavior
INFRASTRUCTURE_ISSUE.evidence: get_cached_behavior_profile, set_cached_behavior_profile, invalidate_behavior_cache are thin wrappers over cachetools TTLCache

account.tested_by: metrics tests (150 tests cover these extensively)

utils.tested_by: core.py unit tests (coefficient_of_variation), properties (normalize_score, coefficient_of_variation, moving_average)

discovery_repair_plan.expected_no_tests_reduction: From 2835 to <500 after discovery repair (estimated 82% reduction)
